title: Tanvi Sharma Storms into Taipei Open Final
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Tanvi Sharma has reached the final of a significant international tournament, showcasing India's rising talent.
summary: Tanvi Sharma defeated home favourite Huang Yu-Hsun to earn her spot in the Taipei Open 2026 final, where she will compete against Nguyen Thuy Linh.

title: Unnati Hooda's Taipei Open Journey Ends in Semis, Tanvi Advances
indian_angle: While Unnati Hooda's strong run concluded in the semifinals, Tanvi Sharma's progression ensures continued Indian representation in the Taipei Open final.
summary: Nguyen Thuy Linh defeated Unnati Hooda in the semifinals, leaving Tanvi Sharma as India's sole representative in the Taipei Open 2026 final.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This rule change will significantly impact the competitive landscape and player development for young Indian shuttlers in national events.
summary: Badminton Association of India has implemented the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.

title: Bhubaneswar U-19 Tournament Now Key for World Junior Selection
indian_angle: The Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament is now crucial for Indian junior players aspiring to qualify for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: The Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament has been postponed, and the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament is now designated as the selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: India Expresses Interest to Host BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: India is actively pursuing the opportunity to host the prestigious BWF World Championships, a significant step for Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued an Expression of Interest to host the BWF World Championships in 2026, signaling India's ambition in global badminton.
